statusReason: Regional Redis, regional S3 object storage, ASG web-node worker exclusion, and SSM-backed ASG web bootstrap now have proof fields. ASG create/attach remains blocked until rolling deployment policy is proven.

evidence: Operator evidence: Mumbai and Cape Town have regional ElastiCache/Valkey.
Operator evidence: EC2 instances can reach regional Redis.
Operator evidence: backend and worker use REDIS_URL=rediss://regional-elasticache:6379/0 and REDIS_TLS=true.
Operator evidence: /api/health/ready reports redis configured=true ready=true in both regions.
.env.production.mumbai.example and .env.production.capetown.example now document rediss:// regional Redis and REDIS_TLS=true.
proofs.condition: ASG web nodes must use the same regional REDIS_URL and REDIS_TLS=true. The local Redis service in docker-compose.yml is retained only for legacy/local-state Compose paths.

evidence: Operator evidence: regional object storage uses S3/default credentials with endpoint=null and mode=default-credentials.
Operator evidence: OBJECT_STORAGE_ENDPOINT, OBJECT_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY, and OBJECT_STORAGE_SECRET_KEY are empty in both regional env files.
.env.production.mumbai.example and .env.production.capetown.example now keep static object storage endpoint and credentials empty.
docker-compose.asg-web.yml has no MinIO service.
proofs.condition: ASG web nodes must use regional S3/default credentials. The local MinIO service in docker-compose.yml is retained only for legacy/local-state Compose paths.

evidence: docker-compose.yml keeps the worker behind profiles: ["worker"].
docker-compose.asg-web.yml contains backend and frontend only, with no worker service.
Both backend Compose modes force RUN_BACKGROUND_WORKERS=false for HTTP backend processes.
Existing standalone regional EC2 worker ownership is explicit: docker compose --profile worker up -d --build backend worker frontend.
Operator evidence: current worker containers run with RUN_BACKGROUND_WORKERS=true.
Operator evidence: COMPLIANCE_PACK_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false in both regions.
proofs.condition: Exactly one worker container per region. ASG web nodes must not start worker containers. COMPLIANCE_PACK_SCHEDULER_ENABLED must stay false unless separately approved. Worker horizontal scaling is not assumed safe.

evidence: scripts/dr/bootstrap-asg-web-node.sh fetches ASG web env values from SSM Parameter Store using --with-decryption.
documents/ops/aws-asg-web-ssm-parameter-manifest.json defines root-env and backend-env parameter names only, with no values.
The bootstrap script writes project .env and backend/.env with 0600 permissions and does not print secret values.

The bootstrap script forces RUN_BACKGROUND_WORKERS=false, RUN_DB_MIGRATIONS_ON_START=false, COMPLIANCE_PACK_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false, REDIS_TLS=true, empty object storage endpoint/static credentials, and OBJECT_STORAGE_FORCE_PATH_STYLE=false.
The bootstrap script starts docker-compose.asg-web.yml backend and frontend only, then verifies /healthz and /api/health/ready through Nginx.
ops/aws/iam/dr/asg-web-instance-profile-policy.template.json defines least-privilege SSM read, scoped KMS decrypt, regional S3 artifact access, and ECR image pull permissions.
proofs.condition: ASG launch templates must call scripts/dr/bootstrap-asg-web-node.sh with the approved region group and AWS region. The instance profile must be scoped to the documented SSM prefix and artifact bucket.

evidence: ALBs are healthy, but no ASG instance refresh policy, deregistration delay, warmup, or rollback automation has been applied.
ASG creation and attachment are explicitly out of scope for this audit.
blockers.requiredResolution: Before ASG apply, approve a rolling policy with max unavailable 1, min healthy capacity 100 percent, ALB target deregistration delay, warmup/grace values, and a rollback path.

conditionsBeforeReaudit: Production DNS remains rolled back to London EC2 until a separate approved DNS cutover.
ASG web nodes use docker-compose.asg-web.yml, not the legacy local-state Compose path.
Redis is external/shared per region and not container-local per EC2 node.
Object storage is shared regional S3/default credentials and not container-local MinIO per EC2 node.
Migrations are run as an explicit one-shot release step, not by every booting instance.
One singleton worker container runs per region outside the ASG web node path.
COMPLIANCE_PACK_SCHEDULER_ENABLED remains false unless separately approved.
Secrets are injected through IAM-authenticated SSM Parameter Store bootstrap with no secret values in logs.
Fresh instance bootstrap is repeatable from image, user data, env, and repository scripts.
ALB health checks use /healthz for shallow liveness or /api/health/ready for dependency readiness according to the rollout phase.
Rolling deploy and rollback behavior are documented and tested against regional test records.
operatorInputsRequiredForConditionalRead: Approved ASG health check grace period, target warmup, deregistration delay, and instance refresh policy.
